svg.title: Meter-reading OCR for a state electricity utility
svg.desc: Production pipeline at Sujanix: photo, meter presence (MobileViTv2), dial detection (YOLO26n-OBB), digital or analog (MobileViTv2), OCR (SVTRv2 with CTC), reading. Served on Triton with nine TensorRT FP16 engines on an NVIDIA L4, behind a canary router with automatic fallback to serverless. 330K requests on the busiest day.
svg.text: Meter-reading OCR for a state electricity utility
One photo in, one reading out: 330K requests on the busiest day.
Triton · 9 TensorRT FP16 engines · NVIDIA L4
